environment.details: Synthetic bootstrap fixture; no real network or user data.

ground_truth.statement: The synthetic client has no direct route off the link, and only the environment proxy carries traffic.

verification.details: The fixture directly controls every typed probe observation.

provenance.summary: Generated from typed in-memory observations solely to bootstrap the replay harness.

notes: The direct-egress row reads WARN only because the cross-probe pass relaxed a failure, which replay must take from derived.status_downgraded and never from the status alone.
